bundle.shortDescription: Mikyas — usage widget for Claude Code & Claude Desktop
bundle.longDescription: Mikyas shows your Claude 5-hour and weekly usage, reset countdowns, model and context % from Claude Code and Claude Desktop in a small always-on-top widget. Reads only local files; never your Claude login. Independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.
